- Confirm it’s going back to your original payment method.
- Note the stated refund timing (e.g., “within 5–10 business days after receipt”).

5) Finish the return
- Click “Confirm” / “Submit return”.
- Download/print the label or save the QR code.
- Pack the jacket (remove old labels, include any required slip).
- Drop it off or have it ready for pickup according to what you chose.
